reason: The monoclinic cell is strongly supported by the peak positions, Z=1 is chemically plausible, and the submitted model captures a credible layered average framework. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: no comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; the trace's own simple full-range profile calculation gave the submitted coordinate set only Rwp about 0.1075 (well above the apparent profile noise), with visible intensity mismatches; and a later locally refined coordinate set fit better but was not submitted. The Pm coordinates came from a 26-variable, regularized local refinement that reached its evaluation limit, while materially distinct symmetry, coordinate, and element-ordering realizations were not systematically instantiated and compared. Thus the evidence supports the cell and framework much more strongly than the submitted symmetry and exact ordered coordinates, and another scientifically motivated solution/refinement attempt could plausibly improve the candidate set.
